result.topic_en: Formula notes on Dirichlet L-functions mod q and their functional equation via Gauss sums, then the explicit formula for the prime-counting function ψ(x) in terms of zeta zeros 1/2+αi, together with a numerical evaluation of the sum Σ1/(αα+1/4) over the zeros.
